military.t: 🟡 Israel Agreed to Direct Talks with Lebanon — Trump Asked
military.d: Netanyahu Thu: 'Following repeated requests from the Lebanese government to open peace negotiations with us, last night I instructed the Cabinet to begin direct negotiations with Lebanon.' Sources tell CNN Trump asked Netanyahu to seek the talks. Lebanon-Israel talks scheduled for Washington next Tuesday. BUT: Lebanese official: 'no negotiations under fire.' Israeli source: 'no ceasefire... talks will be held under fire.' First major de-escalation since war began.

military.d: TCS reported after-hours Thu: Net profit ₹13,750 cr (+12% YoY), revenue ₹70,698 cr. Beat estimates. Final dividend ₹31/share (face value Re 1). FY26 total ₹110/share (₹79 interim + ₹31 final). Stock up 6 consecutive sessions. Market cap ₹9.24 lakh cr. Wipro to consider 6th buyback Apr 16. IT season opens well — Infosys, HCL Tech, Wipro Q4 follow.

Greek bulker NJ Earth + Liberian Daytona Beach also confirmed. UAE Industry Min Sultan Al Jaber: 'Strait of Hormuz is NOT open. Access is being restricted, conditioned and controlled.' Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf (Parliament speaker): 'bilateral ceasefire or negotiations is unreasonable.'

military.t: 🇷🇺 Russia VETOED US-led UN Resolution on Hormuz
military.d: Iran FM Araghchi held call with Russian FM Lavrov Thu. Araghchi expressed appreciation for Russia's veto at UN Security Council of US-led 'unreasonable and one-sided resolution' to reopen Hormuz. Araghchi said safe passage will be possible 'provided the US adheres to its commitments.' New multi-polar architecture: Russia + China both backing Iran, while Germany unfroze direct contact, Pakistan brokering, Japan + S Korea seeking safe passage.

military.d: WH Leavitt: 'First round of talks will take place on Saturday morning local time.' VP Vance leading US team, Witkoff + Kushner on team. Iran ambassador to Pakistan Reza Amiri Moghadam confirmed Iranian delegation arrives Thu night for 'serious talks based on 10 points proposed by Iran.' Trump told NBC he is 'very optimistic' about peace deal. But Leavitt: Iran's 10-point proposal was 'literally thrown in the garbage by President Trump.' Pakistan deployed hundreds of police + paramilitary.

military.t: ⛽ Goldman: Brent >$100 Through 2026 if Hormuz Stays Closed
military.d: Goldman Sachs (Daan Struyven team): Brent will average above $100/barrel through 2026 if Strait of Hormuz remains closed for another month. 'Risks to our price forecast skewed to the upside.' Goldman base case: flows pick up this weekend, gradual one-month recovery to pre-war levels. WTI surged above $100 intraday Thu before settling $97.87. IMF managing director: 'sharp reversal' in global outlook due to Mideast crisis.

War Sec Hegseth on Iran's 460kg HEU: 'They'll give it to us voluntarily... or if we have to do something else ourselves, we reserve that opportunity.' AEOI head Eslami: any attempt to limit Iran enrichment 'will fail.' Iran's 10-point plan demands enrichment rights — non-starter for Trump admin. CSIS: extraction would be 'most complicated special operation in history.' IAEA still has no access since June 2025.

UN Secretary-General Guterres 'unequivocally condemned.' UN High Commissioner Türk: 'nothing short of horrific.' IDF killed personal secretary + nephew of Hezbollah deputy chief Naim Qassem. Israel Thu also struck a bridge in Lebanon. Hezbollah held fire Day 1, fired rockets Day 2.

military.t: 🇩🇪 Germany Unfroze Direct Contact with Iran

Merz coordinating directly with US team heading to Islamabad. Reiterated German willingness to support Hormuz safe passage 'provided there is a mandate and viable framework.' Called NATO-Trump relationship 'transatlantic stress test.' France, Germany, UK, Italy, Canada, Australia, EU all calling for Lebanon inclusion.

Trump considering troop deployment to seize HEU — CSIS: 'most complicated special operation in history.' AEOI head Eslami: any attempt to limit enrichment 'will fail.'

nukes.name: Arak
nukes.info: Heavy-water reactor at Khondab struck Apr 3 (Wikipedia/IDF confirmed). Plutonium pathway facility. IAEA monitoring. Reactor not yet operational at full capacity.

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Built into mountain near Qom. Designed to survive bunker busters. US claimed earlier strikes 'obliterated' enrichment, but IAEA cannot verify. Trump Apr 8: 'no enrichment' — Iran's 10-point plan demands right to enrich. Direct contradiction unresolved.

nukes.name: Yazd (Ardakan)
nukes.info: Yellowcake plant struck Apr 3 (IDF/Wikipedia). Early-stage uranium processing. Damage limits Iran's ability to produce new feedstock for years.

nukes.name: Parchin
nukes.info: Nuclear weapon component testing facility near Tehran. Confirmed damage. Historical site of suspected weaponization research. IAEA denied access for years.

nukes.name: Dimona (Israel)
nukes.info: Iranian missiles hit Arad + Dimona near Israel's Negev nuclear center. 100+ injured. IAEA: no damage to facility. First time area targeted this war.

assessment.body:
Day 42 opens with the most consequential 48 hours of the entire war ahead. The picture is contradictory but converging.

LEBANON DE-ESCALATION LIFELINE
• Netanyahu agreed Thursday to BEGIN DIRECT TALKS with Lebanon
• Per Netanyahu: 'Following repeated requests from the Lebanese government to open peace negotiations with us, last night I instructed the Cabinet to begin direct negotiations with Lebanon'
• Sources tell CNN: TRUMP ASKED Netanyahu to seek the talks
• Lebanon-Israel talks scheduled for WASHINGTON next TUESDAY
• BUT: Lebanese official: 'no negotiations under fire'
• Israeli source: 'no ceasefire... talks will be held under fire'
• Israel ALSO struck a bridge in Lebanon Thursday — Hezbollah fired rockets back
• First major de-escalation pathway since war began

THE FIRST NON-IRANIAN TANKER
• Per Bloomberg/CNBC: First non-Iranian oil tanker since ceasefire crossed Hormuz Thursday
• Symbolic but limited — only 4 ships transited Wed (S&P Global) vs avg 9/day pre-ceasefire
• Greek bulker NJ Earth, Liberian Daytona Beach also confirmed
• UAE Industry Min Sultan Al Jaber: 'The Strait of Hormuz is NOT open'
• Iran deployed sea mines, IRGC published alternate route map
• Tankers warned they will be destroyed without Iranian permission

INDIAN MARKETS — THURSDAY CORRECTION
• Sensex fell 932 pts (1.20%) intraday to 76,629.91
• Nifty 23,760.45 (-236.90 / -0.99%)
• Snapped 5-day rally
• Banks dragged: HDFC + ICICI Bank alone -250 pts
• IndiGo -4% (gave back Wed +10%)
• IT pack (Infosys, HCL Tech) under pressure
• FII selling persistent
• Q4 earnings season opens — Kotak: Nifty50 profit growth just 2.6% YoY
• Morgan Stanley retained Sensex 95,000 target Dec 2026
• Nomura: 'uncertainty elevated, binary risks'

TCS Q4 — BRIGHT SPOT
• Net profit ₹13,750 cr (+12% YoY)
• Revenue ₹70,698 cr — beat estimates
• Final dividend ₹31/share (face value Re 1)
• FY26 total dividend ₹110/share (₹79 interim + ₹31 final)
• Stock up 6 consecutive sessions
• Market cap ₹9.24 lakh cr
• Wipro to consider 6th buyback Apr 16
• Infosys, HCL Tech, Wipro Q4 follow

OIL — REBOUNDING
• US WTI hit $100 intraday Thu, settled $97.87 (+3%)
• Brent settled $95.92 (+1%)
• Goldman Sachs (Daan Struyven team): 'Brent will average more than $100/barrel through 2026 if the Strait of Hormuz remains closed for another month'
• Goldman: 'We continue to see the risks to our price forecast as skewed to the upside'
• IMF managing director: 'sharp reversal' in global outlook
• Crypto rallied: Bitcoin $71,575 (+4%), Ethereum $2,248 (+6.5%) — post-ceasefire boost

IRAN'S POSITION HARDENING
• President Pezeshkian: Israeli strikes are 'BLATANT VIOLATION' and 'DANGEROUS DECEPTION' of ceasefire
• 'Our fingers remain on the trigger'
• New message attributed to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei: declared Iran won the war, demanded compensation
• Iran Aerospace cmdr Gen Mousavi: 'Aggression toward Lebanon is aggression toward Iran' — warned of 'heavy response'
• AEOI head Eslami: any attempt to limit Iran enrichment 'will fail'
• Parliament speaker Ghalibaf: 'bilateral ceasefire or negotiations is unreasonable'
• Iran SNSC: 'until details of this victory are finalized, perseverance and prudence'
• Pro-government Tehran chants 'Death to America' continue

GEOPOLITICAL ARCHITECTURE SHIFTING
• RUSSIA VETOED US-led UN resolution to reopen Hormuz
• Iran FM Araghchi-Lavrov call Thu — appreciation for veto
• GERMANY unfroze direct contact with Iran (Chancellor Merz)
• Merz coordinating with US team to Islamabad
• Britannica earlier confirmed: CHINA gave 'last-minute nudge' for ceasefire to Khamenei
• Japan PM Takaichi called Iran's Pezeshkian directly
• South Korea + EU seeking safe-passage assurances
• France, Germany, UK, Italy, Canada, Australia, EU all demand Lebanon inclusion
• Multi-polar diplomatic architecture replacing US monopoly

INDIA'S CALIBRATED POSITIONING
• EAM Jaishankar to visit UAE Apr 11-12
• MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal: 'closely following developments'
• Foreign Secretary Misri in Washington meeting senior US officials
• J&K CM Omar Abdullah urged US to 'exert control over Israel'
• RBI flagged Hormuz as 'drag on FY27 production'
• India structural shields holding:
  - Only 40% crude via Hormuz (vs EU/Japan 50%+)
  - US 30-day waiver for Russian oil
  - 6-8 weeks fuel stocks
  - Reliance bought 2M Iranian barrels direct (Apr 7)
  - Sea Bird Iranian LPG at Mangalore — first in 7 years
  - 8 of 9 Indian LPG carriers extracted before ceasefire
  - 51 lakh cylinders delivered Mon, ZERO dry-outs
  - 345 Indian fishermen returned
  - Pakistan brokered with India as quiet diplomatic backer

SATURDAY MORNING ISLAMABAD — THE TEST
• Vance + Witkoff + Kushner leading US delegation
• Iran delegation arrived Thursday night
• Trump told NBC: 'very optimistic' about peace deal
• BUT WH Leavitt: Iran's 10-point proposal was 'literally thrown in the garbage by Trump'
• Iran's 10 points include: Hormuz control, enrichment rights, sanctions removal, US troop withdrawal
• These are nonstarters for Trump admin
• Pakistan deployed hundreds of police + paramilitary

NUCLEAR — UNRESOLVED CORE
• Iran's 460kg of 60% HEU still unaccounted at Isfahan + Natanz tunnels
• War Sec Hegseth: 'They'll give it to us voluntarily... or if we have to do something else ourselves, we reserve that opportunity'
• Trump: 'no enrichment'
• Iran: enrichment is non-negotiable
• Direct contradiction unresolved
• CSIS: extraction would be 'most complicated special operation in history'
• Goldman, IMF, RBI all flagging this as the structural risk

WHAT TO WATCH NEXT 48 HOURS
1. Saturday morning Islamabad talks — actual progress?
2. Friday Indian market reaction — does Sensex hold above 76,000?
3. Brent direction — $95-100 range critical
4. Hormuz transit count — 1 ship Thu, can it grow to 5+ Friday?
5. Israel-Lebanon Tuesday Washington talks — preconditions?
6. Hezbollah response to Israeli strikes
7. Iran's negotiating stance — 10-point plan or compromise?
8. China-Russia-EU coordinated diplomatic pressure

BOTTOM LINE
Day 42 opens with the war's most consequential weekend ahead. Wednesday's euphoric rally has corrected. Thursday brought one positive (Israel-Lebanon talks) and one negative (Iran's hardened position + Hormuz mines). Saturday's Islamabad talks are now THE pivot point. If they succeed: Sensex 80,000+, Brent retreats to $85, India's structural shields validated, Reliance's Iranian crude direct purchases reward Mukesh Ambani. If they fail: Trump's 'Shootin Starts' activates, Brent targets $145, Sensex retests 74,000, full re-escalation. India is positioned as well as anyone could be — diplomatically neutral, energy-diversified, foreign-exchange holding, fuel stocks at 6-8 weeks, and quietly becoming a bigger Iranian crude buyer than anyone expected. Friday will be a holding pattern. Saturday will define everything.
